lines: She had been bought by a man called Mr. S.
The man was known as the head of a shady organization that dealt in drugs and demonic potions of Devildomian origin,
and more than that, he was known as a hardcore sadist.
There were untold numbers of women who had fallen prey to Mr. S's twisted desires.

Actresses, idols and other such members of upstanding society, a female executive from a rival organization, an investigator who'd been following him, a young girl he happened to find on the street, a housewife...
The women he was interested in were captured and subjected to all manner of training, torture, and humiliation, never to leave his mansion alive.
Gehehehehe, are you shaking so much because you're afraid of me? Hm? Hm?
Wh-What... are you... going to do to me?
Where's the fun in telling you? I'm just going to teach your body a lesson. Taking my time. Nice and slow.
Hnnngh... N-No... Stop it... Let me go... please...
I'm going to give you so much pain and pleasure that you're going to forget you're even human. I swear it on this kissー*smooch*
*Slurp, slurp, smack* Ohhh, you're a cutie. Your saliva is like honeyー
The body of Mr. S, who had been gleefully devouring her lips, suddenly jumped.
Then he turned over and began writhing on the floor, shaking like he had terrible chills.
Oh-ho, what's the matter? Weren't you going to give me pain and pleasure?
Y-Yhou bhitch... What dhid yhou... dho... M-Mhy stomhach... is bhurningggh!!
Ahaha, so close. It's not burning. It's rotting. From my poison.
A repulsive, rotten stench rose up from the screaming man, and his flesh crumbled into loose clumps.
My spit was delicious, wasn't it? It seems like you've done a lot stuff, but have you ever rotted a person alive?
Gbah, obuh, ebubuh, pobogh, bbbbugh, ebuobuh, bubugh!!!
Too bad. You can't talk anymore. But since your brain will be the last thing to rot, I hope you die while savoring this.
Well then, I guess I'll head home. I ended up killing you with a quick kiss, but all that S&M stuff is a pain. Bye-bye.
The Taimanin Yanagi Mutsuho looked down on Mr. S, rotting from her poison, and smiled smugly.
Word of that mission came after the Taimanin village had been attacked.
Just as they had learned that Major had escaped, and were in the middle of conducting an independent search for her whereabouts.
I'm to go to Tokyo Kingdom as Yanagi-senpai's support?
Sorry to bring this up suddenly, but I thought you'd be perfect as her partner.
Next to Asagi-sensei was Yanagi Mutsuho-senpai, a Gosha Academy graduate.
It was my first time meeting her, but she came from a leading family of Taimanin poison users. She was also a master of scouting, infiltration, and assassination.
I've heard rumors about the Independent Commando Unit. Nice to meet you.
Despite those fearsome abilities and background, she amiably offered her hand.
Same to you. I've heard rumors of your activities as well, Yanagi-senpai.
Call me Mutsuho. No need to be so polite. I'm no good with formal stuff. By the wayー
As I accepted her handshake, senpaiーMutsuho gave my hand a suggestive squeeze.
This hand poisons people. You're not afraid of me?
You wouldn't poison your partner the moment you met them, would you?
Somewhat spooked, I dropped the formalities and answered. I couldn't be so rude as to let go of her hand in a panic.
Indeed. It looks like you're qualified to work with me.
But if you do something uncalled-for, you might fall prey to my poison, okay?
I couldn't tell if she was joking or being serious, but she let go of my hand, which was apparently not being poisoned at the moment.
Asagi-sensei, by Mutsuho's support, you mean there's an assassination target in Tokyo Kingdom?
The target is "Muscle Joe," the boss of the "Muscle Gang," a shady organization that trades in Devildomian technology with the UFS and secret service agency "G."
Something related to the UFS again, huh...
Seeing my dejected face, Asagi-sensei chuckled.
That's one of the reasons I chose you.
If it's about secret service agency "G," it must be that Masked Madam who brought it to our attention, didn't she?
That's right. Once you arrive in Tokyo Kingdom, please meet with our contact from the DSO.
There, preparations have been made for you to get the information and items needed for the mission.
Who is the person from the DSO?
You'll know when you meet them.
I had a feeling things were going to get messy again.
Seems like you've got some things going on as well. But anyway, let's have fun.
In contrast with me, in my state of melancholy, Mutsuho looked oddly amused.
Mutsuho and I had arrived in Tokyo Kingdom.
Having already visited time and time again, I'd become used to the sight of folks from the Devildom walking through the streets normally.
Hey, hey, those two over there, what do you think their relationship is?
While waiting in the spot agreed upon with the DSO, Mutsuho had abruptly struck up conversation.
She was pointing to a male and female demon, a familiar sight in this city.
I guess they're a pair of mercenaries?
Normies or whatever. Hope they drop dead♪
She said something disturbing while laughing.
We had some trouble on the way here, and I was aware of Mutsuho's ability as a poison user.
Her Ninja Art was one that produced and transformed all sorts of poisons inside her body. And it was possible for her to secrete them in her bodily fluids.
On the other hand, it was hard to get a good feel for her personality.
When we first met, I thought she had a friendly personality, uncharacteristic of a poison user. But that was slightly off.
During the mission, she didn't speak more than necessary, and she looked like she didn't care if I was there or not.
And yet, despite all that, she would spit out a toxic line like that just now, as if it had just come to her on the spot.
Want me to go kill them?
No, obviously not. Do you intend to cause a scene in a place like this?
Oh, no, not those normies. The target I mean.
The guy from the UFS must have died somewhere, yeah? If I go kill the target alone, it'll be done in a flash.
No. Asagi ordered us to rendezvous with the DSO here. I don't want to meet them either, but let's wait a bit longer.
Mutsuho shrugged and, perhaps out of boredom, began briskly pushing the needle that was built into her gauntlet in and out.
That was fine in and of itself, but I grew increasingly more uncomfortable considering she could secrete a poison from her hands that could drop a giant elephant in mere seconds...
Just when I decided it was time to stop her...
I suddenly felt as though a freezing icicle had been pressed against my spine.
It was a tremendous intent to kill.
Yoo-hoo. Were you waiting for me?
A voice had suddenly come from behind me.
Oh come on it wasn't that surprising was it? What's going on with you? You seemed pretty tense just now.
Out of nowhere, the familiar face of Kokawa Asuka had appeared.
And the bloodlust had vanished as well.
What in the hell was that? Had it been my imagination?
Hey, what's with that face? I even went through the trouble of coming out here in uniform for you. Well? Cute, right?
Wearing her school uniform, Asuka proudly spun around in place to show it off.
Alright alright, no need to force it. Oh, or should I have worn a wedding dress instead? Like Ange's?
Oh don't think I've forgotten what you put me through with that...
It wasn't all that long ago that I had almost ended up marrying Ange, who I had never even met before, all because of Asuka here.
It wasn't that big a deal. Ange was saying she wanted to have a meal with you again.
Asuka dryly brushed off my sarcasm. She was completely unrepentant.
Hmmm. She a friend of yours?
Mutsuho asked in a strangely loaded tone.
Hardly. She's no friend at all. Couldn't possibly be.
Awww, so mean. I've helped you out of plenty tough spots until now, you ungrateful jerk.
Yeah? And just how many of those were ones you got me into? You damn jinx...
Wow. And here I came out just to help you when I heard you were the one coming!
Am I supposed to be happy to hear that? I'd rather have Ange come. Her rice balls are delicious.
I-I can make rice balls too you know!
You probably squeeze them so hard they turn into rice cakes!
Wha-! H-How did you know!? Did Ange tell you?
Ha! I didn't even need to ask her. Just one look at you and it's obvious!
Mrrrrrrngh, you're really pissing me off now...
All that stuff aside... did you bring what we agreed on?
We've been waiting foreeeever so if you could hurry it up that'd be just great.
Mutsuho's irritated interjection snapped us out of our little spat we were having.
Oh, I'm so sorry. I haven't even introduced myself yet. I am Kokawa Asuka of the DSO. And you are...?
She's Yanagi Mutsuho, my senpai. I'm acting as her support.
Oh, I see. Nice to meet you.
Ummm... So, here's your funding, as well as the state-of-the-art supplements developed by the UFS, as promised.
With a puzzled look at Mutsuho's reaction, Asuka had held out a suitcase.
They say that Muscle Joe, the head of the Muscle Gang, is a health food fanatic.
When I opened the case, I found a considerably large amount of money and a few bottles of supplements inside.
Odd that the boss of an underground organization dealing in Devildomian technology is a health food fanatic of all things.
And with a name like "Muscle?" But the information the DSO obtained is solid.
So that's how it was. This had become a joint operation with the DSO because operational funds aside we needed the latest supplements from the UFS as bait.
Rumor has it he impregnates girls and then rips the babies out to eat for his own health!
Isn't it? Absolute scum. We can't let him get away with it!
Asuka had clenched her mechanical fist with a creak in indignation, but Mutsuho huffed loudly through her nose.
Fetuses have always been good medicine. It's nothing unusual.
You don't think it's terrible!? You are a woman, aren't you?
Mutsuho gave the flaring Asuka a look and mockingly shrugged her shoulders.
Who knows? I've been steeped in poison since birth so I've got no hope of having a baby. Even if it was by force it'd be nice to just be able to conceive.
Yep. All so my body could remember all kinds of poisons and reproduce them internally.
Asuka then looked to me as if to say "What is she talking about?"
The Mutsuho have been a poison-using clan for generations. I don't know the details myself, but I've heard taking poison little by little hones their abilities.
And apparently, I have some of the strongest poisons they've ever seen.
They say that kids are out of the question even with a man of my own clan.
Having now heard Mutsuho's situation, Asuka could do nothing but stand there awkwardly and unable to speak.
Don't give me that look. You're not exactly normal either it seems.
Even so, I don't think I'd want to find comfort with another broken woman.
Wha-!? You don't have to say it like that!
Oh, well then I do hope you'll enlighten me with the exact phrasing that's to your liking.
Will you two knock it off? Let's get back to the mission.
I was forced to admonish the standoffish pair before it got any worse.
To which Mutsuho then began to unveil her assassination plan as if the previous exchange had never even happened.
Ok, so my plan goes like this.
Posing as a slave trader, Fuma will bribe another slaver with connections to Muscle Joe to get us an in with him.
Then, he'll sell me off to the boss as a new slave, along with these supplements as a gift.
Hey, now just hold on a sec...
I'll make contact with Muscle Joe, and once he ends up trying to violate me, that's when I'll assassinate him with my poison Ninja Art.
Fuma, you can just give me whatever support you can while I'm undercover as a slave.
Ignoring my attempts to stop her, Mutsuho finished her triumphant speech and then turned to question me.
That's far too dangerous. It's too unpredictable to know what will happen to you as a slave. We should think of another plan.
That's the way I always do it. I just got rid of someone the other day by becoming his prostitute.
I'm against it, too. It's too dangerous to become a slave to some perverted baby-eating bastard.
I can do it, even if you can't. Just by embracing a man I can kill him with the poison that courses through my body.
Asagi-sensei already gave her approval too, of course. But it's not refined enough for your tastes I suppose.
She was being unusually belligerent now. She hadn't acted like this at all until this point.
It's not about whether or not it suits my tastes. My guess is that Asagi-sensei had something in mind when she paired us together because you always operate alone.
Anyway, we shouldn't move too hastily. We need to gather information as well, so we should find a place to stay and talk things through first.
You sure are cautious. Well, you are my partner after all. And a short rest at a hotel might be nice even.
With that, we found a place to stay for the night. But just when I was ready to start our three-person strategy session...
I'm not interested in any other plan, so call me when you two decide something, m'kay?
And with that, Mutsuho made for her room, leaving us alone.
She said this in an unusually disheartened manner, perhaps concerned about the argument they had earlier.
It's not your fault. It was just bad timing.
But are you okay with this? Your mission was just to give me the money and supplements, right?
Somehow, Asuka was also getting roped into helping to plan the assassination of Muscle Joe.
Don't worry about me. I'm just doing this because I want to.
Wh-, whatever, I said it's fine. You don't have to bow your head like that.
Asuka's cheeks had blushed in embarrassment, as if she were unaccustomed to being properly thanked.
Anyway! Back to planning! Let's go!
Mutsuho had left us, but I proposed my plan with slight modifications to that initial one.
In short, we'd let Mutsuho infiltrate, not as a slave, but as a servant, with the objective of mapping out the Muscle Gang's home base.
It would be less dangerous since wasn't making immediate contact with the boss.
Plus if it was just mapping the base, she wouldn't have to spend so long undercover.
Once that was done, we'd hire some mercenaries and use them to attack the Muscle Gang base with a more powerful force.
In doing so, we would lure as much of the enemy as we could to one place and round them up with Mutsuho's poison gas attack.
Then Asuka, who would be invisible with her optical camouflage ability, would close in on their boss, Muscle Joe, and assassinate him.
Not bad. But she might not like that I'm now the one who deals the finishing blow to the boss.
This is the safest and most sure-fire way I can think of. Mutsuho seems to be getting way too ahead of herself anyway.
But you have to be the one to convince her. I can't.
But I had to give it my all, as Mutsuho's support.
So I headed to Mutsuho's room to talk it out with her.
And yetーin a turn of events that maybe we should've predicted...
There was no one in the pitch black room.
There weren't even any signs of Mutsuho having used it.
Fuma! We've got a problem! The money and the supplements are both gone!
Asuka came flying into the room after me.
It seemed that part of the money, the amount we'd planned to give to the slave trader with ties to Muscle Joe as a bribe, and the supplement gift had disappeared.
She's going to carry out that plan of hers all by herself!
But we had noticed far too late it seemed.
We found out from the slave trader who was connected to Muscle Joe that he'd already sold Mutsuho.
Be that as it may, we headed for the Muscle Gang's home base.
It was a modern, intelligently designed building. One unbefitting of an evil boss who eats unborn children.
The entrance was lined with fully armed guards.
Security is tighter than I thought...
Were their defenses usually this tight?
Does she want to do this alone that badly?
While taking stock of the security, Asuka brought another matter back to my attention.
Solo assassinations are her forte, but Asagi-sensei went out of her way to have me accompany her this time.
Not a Taimanin who can be useful in battle, but me. She must be uneasy about having Mutsuho going it alone.
No, but it's the only reason I can think of.
Perhaps Mutsuho had also sensed Asagi's apprehension, which instead made her even more insistent on her solo strategy.
If so, this was even worse than I thought.
I took a moment to think, then gave her my response.
It'll be tough without Mutsuho mapping things out for us, but we'll have to recruit mercenaries as planned.
Huh, that's a little surprising. I thought you'd say we should launch the attack immediately.
What's the point of us all jumping the gun together? From here we have to make sure we do all we can to support her.
Understood. I know a shop nearby where those types hang out.
But it would take several days to gather mercenaries.
In the meantime, we could only pray that Mutsuho would be safe.
I took another look at the enemy home base where Mutsuho was and tried to leave, when...
I suddenly felt something cold pressed against my neck from behind.
Hey, what're you doing in a place like this?
This voice, and this killing intent...
Hmhmmm, you remembered me. I'm so glad.
The seductive yet cold breath gradually tickled my neck along with the blade that was pointed at me.
So that bloodlust back then hadn't been my imagination. It had been this woman.
Sonia as in that Sonia? I can't believe I didn't notice her presence...

"
It seemed that Asuka knew about this homicidal maniac formerly of the UFS."
She was astonished by Sonia's ability to sneak up behind me before she knew it.
I know about you. Your specialty is taking advantage of the blind spots in UFS cyborgs. Don't move.
There was no moving. Not for myself nor for Asuka.
If we moved even a step, I'd get my neck slit open.
Whoa whoa, I thought you came to say hello! Hey, it's been a while, kid!
When I turned just my eyes toward yet another familiar voice...
He was the old orc mercenary from when Sakura and I had played mercenary in this city who, alongside us, had been tricked by Faust and ended up fighting at our side.
I don't suppose that energetic little lady Taimanin Sakura here today? Though it seems like you're enjoying yourself with a couple lovely ladies at your sides already!
Feel free to point them out...
Gwahahahaha, you're the same as always. Ease up on the kidding around, Sonia. The kid really doesn't like it.
Who's kidding? Looking at you's got my body throbbing again.
With the feeling like a thin layer of skin on my neck being cut, Sonia had backed away from me.
Did you read my love letter?
...Ummm, what kind of relationship do you two have?
Seems like she wants to either kill me or be killed by me.
Even now I still feel the pain and pleasure of having my flesh ripped open by you. It was so good.
Asuka was completely taken aback by Sonia, who was writhing her body enticingly.
We should kill each other too. As women who've both had their bodies were toyed with by the UFS.
Sounds like she's taken a liking to you.
Gwahahaha!!! You attract some seriously interesting women, kid. Like that Sakura!
We ran into a little trouble in this city one time. Ended up fighting together. He's a very resourceful mercenary.
Nice to meet you, little cyborg lady. Are all your limbs mechanical? I just love that. And you look great in that uniform, too.
Asuka smiled in satisfaction when she was complimented for her uniform, which I hadn't praised at all, in addition to his compliments of her cyborg limbs.
You're looking good, Orc dude. I thought you had left this city already?
Heh-heh! That was until I heard inside info that Muscle Joe of the Muscle Gang is recruiting mercenaries for a high price.
Same goes for Sonia here. We happened to be staying together, and we hit it off when we found out we were going to be Muscle Joe's mercenaries.
And so we were on our way to the Muscle Gang's hideout when I saw you.
Back up a bit. Muscle Joe's recruiting mercenaries at a high price?
Yeah and it's quite a bit higher than I've ever heard of. Rumor's going around that they're going to go head-to-head with some organization.
Orc dude, Sonia, forget Muscle Joe and come work for me. I'll pay you plenty.
Whoa, hey now, what's this all of a sudden? Not that I mind, but who's on the other end?
I told the Orc dude about how we had been targeting Muscle Joe and that one of our friends was already infiltrating.
Well well, so you plan to kill that health fanatic, too.
Wait, "too?" Weren't you supposed to be Muscle Joe's mercenary?
Of course I intend to. But I just think it's a little unacceptable that the head of an underground organization is a health nut.
I figured I'd work as his mercenary, get paid, and then get a quick kill on my way home.
Hey whoa, that's pretty excessive. You're a disgrace to mercenaries everywhere, you are.
Damn. But if that's your plan then you've got me with ya, kid. I still owe ya for last time.
Thanks a lot, Orc dude. And what about you, Sonia?
Fine with me. Fighting together with you is exciting in its own way.
Alright, we're charging in there immediately.
Huh!? Shouldn't we have more mercenaries than this?
The situation's changed. Mutsuho's in danger.
The timing for Muscle Joe suddenly gathering up mercs is a little too convenient, don't you think?
We have to think of the worst case scenario in situations like this. Like the plan to assassinate Muscle Joe leaking.
And it's unfortunate, but that guess is probably the correct one.
Got it. I trust your judgment at times like these.
Within the underground prison of the Muscle Gang home baseー
There was a hulking man reminiscent of a metal sculpture.
His exposed body was a mass of muscles, and his silvery skin gave off a dull sheen.
Perhaps due to his body being constantly charged by electricity, small electric sparks endlessly flew across the steel surface of his steel muscles.
This was the leader of the Muscle Gang, Muscle Joe himself.
The strange-looking metal demon was having some conversation on his smartphone while greedily gobbling down a pile of supplements.
Yeah, the information was good. I appreciate it.
She's a dreadful girl. One of my subordinates died in the blink of an eye just from being touched by her.
Right. It's just me now. Yeah, I'm alright. No need to worry.
Yes, we're still okay for business. I appreciate the information, Mine-san. Goodbye...
Muscle Joe hung up the phone and tossed more supplements into his mouth.
*Munch munch munch* These are wonderful. My whole body is brimming with energy. Feels like I just keep getting healthier.
You wanna be healthy that badly?
Across from Muscle Joe was Mutsuho.
She had already given up the slave act.
She wore a faint smile on her face, and around her feet lay the bodies of countless corpses.
Each of the faces of Muscle Joe's men displayed expressions of terrible anguish after having been killed by her poison.
Of course! As they say, a sound mind dwells within a sound body, does it not?
The ultimate body of health. That's what I am. *Munch munch munchーgulp* Mm, delicious.
Even though you forcibly impregnate girls and then eat their babies?
Mutsuho still wore the same smile. She seemed to be expecting the answer that came from her adversary.
Heh, baseless accusations. The impregnating slaves part is true though.
I offer up the unborn children. And in exchange, I receive this sound body.
You offer them? To get that body?
That's right. It was through a deal with a devil that I obtained this body.
Muscle Joe lifted his fist-clenched arms upward with a jerk and let his metal muscles bulge proudly.
Poison is useless against me. Feast your eyes upon this beautiful specimen of health!
Just as those muttered words left her mouth, Mutsuho instantly closed in to within arms reach of Muscle Joe.
Her poison kills an enemy on contact without a sound. It's a method of killing with extreme speed that was handed down in the Yanagi clan.
She touched his posed arm and injected her powerful poison that was capable of rotting through flesh into his supposed "healthy body."
Mutsuho had spoken coldly and then tried to back away from her enemy who would soon begin to rot.
Muscle Joe's robust arm violently gripped hers.
I told you it's useless, little Taimanin girl. Poison has no effect on my flawless healthy body.
While still held in his grasp, Mutsuho threw a kick at Muscle Joe's jaw.
Of course she'd secreted plenty of poison. But it still didn't seem to have any effect.
Muscle Joe released Mutsuho's arm and then slammed his clenched fist into her stomach.
Although it didn't look like he'd put any power into it, Mutsuho had been blown away and doubled over from the impact as if she'd been struck by a huge hammer.
Mutsuho writhed on the ground as she spat up poison-mixed blood.
What a filthy body you have. Just brimming with poison.
But with this body of mine, I'm still able to impregnate you.
M-My poison's... none of your business... I'd never have a baby... *Cough* ...just to... sacrifice it to a devil...
Mutsuho staggered to her feet with intense anger in her eyes.
Oh no, I'll make sure you get pregnant. But first, how about a little exercise?
I'll break your arms and legs, shatter your ribs, pluck out your eyes, and tear off your ears.
Let's see if I can convince you to accept me willingly.
Not if my poison... kills you first... bastard...
